headline: Hike odds 60% into FOMC Sep 16, Jazan refinery halted, no US data today
stance: Tuesday's 10-year move was all breakeven, real yields flat — an oil price shock, not faster growth. Nothing on the US calendar today.

news.head: Houthi missiles hit four Saudi cities
news.body: Aramco suspended operations at the 400,000 b/d Jazan refinery and at Najran and Abha early Tuesday. 73 wounded.

news.head: Crude up again overnight
news.body: WTI $94.56, +1.64% (~6am ET). Third straight session higher.

news.head: Bab al-Mandeb is now a second chokepoint
news.body: The Houthi campaign threatens the peninsula's western route. Hormuz traffic was already the risk.

news.head: Apple's iPhone event today
news.body: Apple holds its annual iPhone launch event today. Chewy and American Eagle report today.

implications: Jazan is domestic refining, not export capacity. The market is pricing the next target, not this one.
Crude near $100 and a 60% hike chance coexist. Energy is being read as inflation, not as a growth tax.

watch.head: PPI, Sep 10, 8:30
watch.body: First inflation read before the meeting. Energy passes through producer prices before consumer prices.

watch.head: CPI, Sep 11, 8:30
watch.body: The last inflation print before the meeting. A hot pair with producer prices settles the hike.

watch.head: Gold, and whether it stops falling
watch.body: Gold fell Tuesday while crude rose and the dollar eased. Spec length sits at the 93rd percentile of three years.

watch.head: Whether spreads price the oil move
watch.body: Nothing in investment grade or high yield has moved since the strikes began. That gap closes one way or the other.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Copper at the 100th percentile of three years, crude at the 94th. Both rose Tuesday.
No US release today. First test: PPI, Sep 10, 8:30.
Hike odds 60% (~6am ET). Crude, not the labor data, is doing the repricing.
sections.positioning: Speculators hold almost no long 3M SOFR, the 1st percentile of three years, twenty weeks running. Standing background, not new.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: The Dow lost more than three times what the Nasdaq-100 did Tuesday. Oil is being charged to industrials.
Breadth broke Tuesday: 40.8% of the S&P above its 50-day, from 48.1% Friday.
Futures flat pre-market (~6am ET): S&P +0.04%, Nasdaq +0.14%, Dow -0.06%.
sections.positioning: Speculators short VIX at the 10th percentile of three years, a fourth week, net -20.5% of open interest. Standing background.

single_name.note: Mesa Laboratories joined the list Tuesday. Two insider rules fired, trades above its 200-day, 1.99 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Spreads have not moved in a week. Investment grade and high yield priced none of the oil move.
Equity-credit correlation 0.63, from 0.66 last week. Equities are taking the geopolitical risk, credit is not.
Loan syndication yields 7.2%, marked Monday. Leveraged borrowers have not been asked to pay for crude yet.
sections.positioning: Speculators short high-yield futures at the 3rd percentile of three years, a fourth week. Extended short into the meeting.

ideas.line: 5 open · 0 closed — no hit rate until 10 (too few to mean anything)
